arguments.query: select b.booking_id,b.status,b.amount_cents,(select count(*) from holds h where h.booking_id=b.booking_id) holds,c.* from bookings b left join charges c on c.booking_id=b.booking_id where b.status="pending"
select service,path,status,message,count(*) n from (select * from request_logs order by rowid desc limit 150) where status>=400 group by 1,2,3,4

select status,count(*) from bookings group by 1 union all select "outbox_"||status,count(*) from outbox group by 1 union all select "checkins",count(*) from checkins union all select "confirmed_no_checkin",count(*) from bookings b where status="confirmed" and not exists(select 1 from checkins c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id)
select service,method,path,status,message,max(rowid) r,count(*) n from (select rowid,* from request_logs order by rowid desc limit 80) where status!=200 group by 1,2,3,4,5

select "b"||status s,count(*) from bookings group by 1 union all select "o"||status,count(*) from outbox group by 1 union all select "chk",count(*) from checkins union all select "nohold",count(*) from bookings b where status="confirmed" and not exists(select 1 from holds h where h.booking_id=b.booking_id) union all select "chg_"||state,count(*) from charges group by 1 union all select "dupref",count(*) from (select client_reference from bookings where status="confirmed" and client_reference is not null group by 1 having count(*)>1) union all select "refunds",count(*) from refunds
select rowid,service,path,status,duration_ms,message from request_logs where status>=500 or duration_ms>150 order by rowid desc limit 20
select f.*,(select count(*) from holds h where h.flight_id=f.flight_id) holds,(select count(*) from bookings b where b.flight_id=f.flight_id and status="confirmed") conf from flights f
select rowid,service,path,status,message from request_logs where service="booking" order by rowid desc limit 14
select * from customer_events order by rowid desc limit 8
select sql from sqlite_master where name in ("customer_events","bookings")
